card.statement: For such a choice of Borel subgroup $\widetilde{B}$, hence of positive roots, the dominant weights for $T^{\vee}_{\mathbf{k}}$ are exactly the dominant coweights $X_{*}(T)^{+}$ of $T$ (for the choice of the positive roots as the $T$ -weights in the Lie algebra of $B$ ).
card.label: Lemma 9.5

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
